lenses.summary:
L5, internal linking. Report: F:\Claude\gptbot-snippets-translator-20261024\docs\seo\research\2026-10-24-growth-audit\L5-internal-linking.md. Data and scripts: l5-data\ (l5_link_graph.py, l5_analyze.py, l5_anchor_check.py, l5_link_plan.json, gsc_page_28d_all.tsv with GSC resultId 7081b224…). I spent 0 credits.

Findings from an offline crawl of dist/:
- **Structure is fine.** 300 pages, all indexable and all in the sitemap. 4 581 unique internal edges: 0 broken, 0 through a redirect, 0 orphans.
- **Click depth is not a problem.** 294 pages sit at depth 1 because the shell of "/" lists 294 URLs. Depth 2: /ru/oferta/, /uz/oferta/, /ru/prezentatsiya-ai/, /uz/taqdimot-ai/. Depth 3: /uz/tariflar/.
- **Link weight is spread the wrong way round.** The top 20 pages by internal PageRank (the two chats excluded) are lists, author pages and B2B landings. Together they got 1 520 impressions in 28 days. The B2C pages with demand rank low: download guide #37, login guide #53, payment #210, ChatGPT-and-Claude #232. Of 60 pages with 50+ impressions, 26 have 2 or fewer links from body text (5 343 impressions, 71 clicks). Spearman correlation of impressions with inbound links is 0.30–0.33.
- **The strongest donors are locked.** 7 of the 9 pages with 10+ clicks are protected, and 3 of them are inside measurement windows. Many weak pages with demand must not get links because they compete with the intent owner: CGO, GCB, the AI-manager blogs, the Payme/Click pair, chat-bot-dlya-sayta, /uz/gpt-bot-biznes-uchun/.
- **Anchor violations.** 4 anchors on unprotected pages contradict C10/C23. 1 anchor on the protected promptlar page contradicts C30.

The plan has 24 link insertions, each with its file, block, exact sentence and anchor:
- **Wave 1 (13 links, unprotected sources, can ship now).**
- **Wave 2 (6 links, protected articles).** Payment, Claude and promptlar after the R-S1 read (≈07.11). Download guide together with L2-04 (≈16.11). Login guide after the 23.10 read (≈20.11).
- **Wave 3 (5 links, both chats).** After the 28-day snippet read, ≈25.11.

Impact can't be measured from this data (L1 §3), so every item is "unknown" with a ceiling of impressions × 3.59 % (position-3 cell, L1 §3.3) minus current clicks:
- Wave 1, GSC-based ceiling: about +30…+50 clicks per 28 days in total.
- UZ school guides (tushuntirish/ariza, kurs ishi, biznes reja), demand-based ceiling: ≈342 clicks per 28 days if they reached top 3. Their donors are protected, so this is waves 2–3.

Not proposed: changes to "/", links to competing URLs, the studio (already L4-05), and a B2C footer swap.
